fl: It communicates with others by lighting up its rear at night. It loves ILLUMISE's sweet aroma.

name: Weedle

name: Whismur

atk.x: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 10 damage to each of your opponent's Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

fl: Usually, its cries are like quiet murmurs. If frightened, it shrieks at the same volume as a jet plane.

name: Wingull
fl: It makes its nest on steep sea cliffs. Riding updrafts, it soars to great heights.

name: Zigzagoon

atk.x: Search your discard pile for any 1 card, show it to your opponent, and put it on top of your deck.
Flip 2 coins. This attack does 10 damage times the number of heads.

fl: It walks in zigzag fashion. It is good at finding items in the grass and even in the ground.

name: Amulet Coin
ru: Attach Amulet Coin to 1 of your Pokémon that doesn't already have a Pokémon Tool attached to it. If that Pokémon is Knocked Out, discard this card.
If the Pokémon Amulet Coin is attached to is your Active Pokémon at the end of your turn, draw a card.

name: Felicity's Drawing
ru: You can play only one Supporter card each turn. When you play this card, put it next to your Active Pokémon. When your turn ends, discard this card.
Discard up to 2 cards from your hand. If you discard 1 card, draw 3 cards. If you discard 2 cards, draw 4 cards.

name: Leftovers
ru: Attach Leftovers to 1 of your Pokémon that doesn't already have a Pokémon Tool attached to it. If that Pokémon is Knocked Out, discard this card.
If the Pokémon Leftovers is attached to is your Active Pokémon at the end of your turn, remove 1 damage counter from the Pokémon.

name: Moonlight Stadium
ru: This card stays in play when you play it. Discard this card if another Stadium card comes into play. If another card with the same name is in play, you can't play this card.
The Retreat Cost for each Psychic and Darkness Pokémon (both yours and your opponent's) is 0.

name: Premier Ball
ru: Search your deck or your discard pile for a Pokémon LV.X, show it to your opponent, and put it into your hand. If you search your deck, shuffle your deck afterward.

name: Rare Candy
ru: Choose 1 of your Basic Pokémon in play. If you have a Stage 1 or Stage 2 card that evolves from that Pokémon in your hand, put that card on the Basic Pokémon. (This counts as evolving that Pokémon.)

ru: Put this card onto your Active Cresselia. Cresselia LV.X can use any attack, Poké-Power, or Poké-Body from its previous level.
